unplayedCards.name: BUDDY
unplayedCards.effect: Normal form: cards played in BUDDY's district cost 1 less Motion (minimum 0). After two rounds, BUDDY gains +3 Hands and planted Buddy Buds sprout. On reveal, plant Buds in two or three randomly chosen eligible districts; when each Bud sprouts, it gives +3 Hands to the last eligible friendly character already in its district. Full districts are skipped; Buds that sprout with no eligible friendly recipient remain harmless and give no Hands. Buds planted too late to sprout before match end are not placed.

unplayedCards.name: FOLKS
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply 3 Burn to every enemy on the board. Give every other friendly Fire character +1 Hand. Burn deals its stacked Hands loss once at round end; Fire deals +1 Burn against Plant.

unplayedCards.name: GUAP
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hands for each other friendly character across the board, up to +5. Give every enemy across the board -1 Hands. Once per round. Ongoing: While GUAP is in your hand, your other Fire characters gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Boss Bae
unplayedCards.effect: The first 2 times you play a card in another district, gain +1 Hands. After the second, your next card costing 4 or more costs 1 less Motion.

unplayedCards.name: Scammer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Copy the base Hands (up to 7) and printed ability of the strongest active Ongoing enemy here. If none exists, copy only the strongest enemy's base Hands (up to 7) and gain +1 Hand. Copied entrances never trigger.

unplayedCards.name: Closet Nerd
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Silence the highest-Hands active Ongoing enemy here, otherwise the strongest enemy, bypassing Wifey's Side Eye. Protection still blocks this. Newly interrupting an active Ongoing ability grants +1 Hand and reveals one enemy hand card.

unplayedCards.name: Live Streamer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Reset your cheap-play trigger counter. The next 2 cards you play this turn with cost 2 or less gain +1 Hand each.

unplayedCards.name: Gamer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands ally in each other district +2 Hands. Ongoing: While on board, the first time each round you newly Silence or Weaken an enemy, your lowest-Hands Dark ally gains +2 Hands. Ongoing: While Gamer is in your hand, your other Dark characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Techbro Rich
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Borrow up to 1 Motion, up to the cap. At round end repay unspent borrowed Motion; any remainder reduces your next round starting Motion. Once per match.

unplayedCards.name: Bikelife YN
unplayedCards.effect: After reveal, ride to your weakest other district and gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Hooper
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Challenge the strongest enemy here through next round. If it leaves this district, gain +3 Hands. Otherwise, at the end of next round, hit it for 3 and gain +1 Hand. One challenge per Hooper.

unplayedCards.name: Barber Bro
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus Hands. Give the amount actually trimmed to your weakest other ally here. If no enemy has bonus Hands, give that ally +1 Hand. Ongoing: While Barber Bro is in your hand, your other Normal characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Bottle Girl
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If played on Round 4 or later, gain +2 Hands. Your next Poison character costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1, through the next round.

unplayedCards.name: Sneaker Reseller
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +X Hands where X is the printed Power of the highest-Hands enemy on the board, up to +3. Apply Weaken to that enemy.

unplayedCards.name: Landlord
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first enemy card played at this district each round costs 1 additional Motion. When that tax is actually paid, Landlord gains +1 Hands once per round.

unplayedCards.name: Car Meet Kid
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move Car Meet Kid to your weakest other district. Then give its lowest-Hands other friendly card +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Nail Tech
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give another friendly card here +2 Hands. The next time that card is hit by an enemy Hands reduction, reduce that loss by 1. Ongoing: While Nail Tech is in your hand, your other Poison characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: OG Uncle
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If your opponent has more total cards on the board than you, gain +3 Hands. If they have at least 3 more, also give their lowest-Hands card here -1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Delivery Demon
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move the lowest-Hands other friendly 1- or 2-Cost card here to your weakest other district.

unplayedCards.name: Young Bull
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand. If an enemy is here, also apply 1 Burn to the highest-Hands enemy here.

unplayedCards.name: Racially Ambiguous Transplant
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have no other cards here, gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Bad Lil Cousin Tayaty
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand, then repeat the last resolved On Reveal if it is repeatable, using Tayaty as its source. If it cannot be repeated, gain Protection instead. Persistent creative contracts cannot be re-armed.

unplayedCards.name: Edgar
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly character here costs 2 or less, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Nguyen
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have a friendly card in another district, gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Man-Man
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have at least 2 other friendly characters here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Earthy Sugar Foot
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other card here +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Shiesty YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: 50% chance to summon another Shiesty YN here. Each summoned copy repeats this effect, up to 8 extra.

unplayedCards.name: Torta
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Pair yourself with your weakest other Earth ally here and Protect that partner. At next round end (or final round end), if both remain here and you are not losing this district, each gains +3 Hands. One pair per side. Ongoing: While Torta is in your hand, your other Earth characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Balikbayan Box Bot
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Leave a care package in each other district through next round. The next ally played or moved there gains +1 Hand (+2 if Earth) and is cleansed. One package per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: Bodega Cat
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have no other friendly cards here, gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Corner Busker
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first distinct other ally moving here gives your weakest other local ally +1 Hand; the second gives +2. At most one two-visitor payout per round. A visitor cannot tip twice toward a payout.

unplayedCards.name: Corner Coach
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Coach your weakest eligible ally here through next round. Later friendly placements retry its failed entrance until one succeeds. Coachable: Edgar, Nguyen, Man-Man, Transplant, Bodega Cat, Dog Walker, Sports Prodigy, Homeless YN, Dragonfly Jones, OG Uncle, Barber Bro, Night Shift Medic, Squabble House Worker — Female, The Feds. If nobody qualifies, give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands instead.

unplayedCards.name: Night Cashier
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: On round 4 or later, issue a Receipt here through next round. Your next other character costing 2 or less played here earns an immediate one-use local 1-Motion character discount, minimum 1. In the final round, that customer gains +2 Hands instead.

unplayedCards.name: Dog Walker
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If at least 2 other friendly characters are here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Mural Apprentice
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Paint this district with your element through next round. The next other friendly character of a different element entering here gains +2 Hands. One paint per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: Chess Regular
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy in up to two different districts through next round. With one mark, wait for an enemy placement in another district to complete the Fork. The next enemy placement after completion saves that district; other marked enemies lose 2 Hands. If a marked enemy loses Hands, Chess Regular gains +1 Hand. One Fork per side.

unplayedCards.name: Rooftop Gardener
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Plant a Seed here. At the end of this round, your weakest Plant ally here gains +4 Hands. One plot per district per side. Ongoing: While Rooftop Gardener is in your hand, your other Plant characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Pirate Radio DJ
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands ally in each other district +1 Hand. Ongoing: In hand, your other Electric characters gain +1 Hand at round end. On board, your second Electric character played each round gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Dance Circle Captain
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, the first friendly character move sets a destination. The next different friendly character moving there gains +2 Hands and Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Subway Magician
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here, then move to your weakest other district.

unplayedCards.name: Last Train Conductor
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your lowest-Hands other ally here to your weakest other district. If moved, Cleanse it and give it +2 Hands, or +3 if it is Water.

unplayedCards.name: Midnight Mayor
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Nominate your weakest other district through next round. The next friendly move there grants that mover Protection and opens one local 1-Motion character discount, minimum 1. One nomination per side.

unplayedCards.name: Big Zoey
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other ally here +2 Hands and the lowest-Hands enemy here -2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Block Party Titan
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Bring the weakest movable ally from each other district here, if there is space. Gain +1 Hand for each ally that arrives, up to +2.

unplayedCards.name: Energy Drink
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Restore 3 Motion, up to the 9-Motion cap.

unplayedCards.name: Phone Charger
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Restore 1 Motion per friendly character here, up to 3. With at least 3 characters here, also Protect your weakest local Electric character.

unplayedCards.name: First Aid Kit
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest afflicted character here, or your weakest character if none is afflicted. Store one emergency kit: prevent up to 2 Hands of its next enemy damage before lethal resolution. One kit per target.

unplayedCards.name: Boombox
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give every friendly character here +1 Hand. Leave one Encore through next round: the next friendly movement arrival here gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Subway Map
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your lowest-Hands friendly character here to your weakest other district. If moved, give it +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Buttahs
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands friendly character here +2 Hands and protect it from one targeted hostile ability.

unplayedCards.name: Homeless YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If enemies outnumber your other friendly cards here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Sports Prodigy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If losing this district, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hand. Otherwise, arm one comeback through next round (once per match): when an enemy arrival turns this district from tied or winning to losing, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Fein
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +1 Hand. If 2 or more enemies are here, also apply 1 Burn to the highest-Hands enemy.

unplayedCards.name: Stoner Jr.
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your lowest-Hands frozen or silenced friendly character here. If cleansed, give it +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Divorced Dad
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable ally costing 2 or less from another district here if there is room; Protect it. Through next round, its first successful move back to its original district gains +1 Hand. It never returns automatically. One visit per side.

unplayedCards.name: BBL Nice
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Pair your two weakest other allies anywhere through next round. Once per round, the first positive Hands gain on one shares up to 2 Hands with the other. Shared gains cannot repeat.

unplayedCards.name: BBL Demon
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy district with Drama until the next enemy character placement or match end. Played there: that character gets -2 Hands. Played elsewhere: BBL Demon gains +2 Hands. One Drama per side.

unplayedCards.name: Krump
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Yung Hustle
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If a friendly character is in another district, restore 1 Motion, up to 9.

unplayedCards.name: Failed Rapper
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Leave a Verse here through next round. The next different friendly character entering by play or movement gains +2 Hands. Played characters collect after their entrance. One Verse per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: Failed Athlete
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per match, gain +4 Hands and Protection when this district changes from tied or winning to losing. If deployed while losing, a later enemy arrival here while still losing can also trigger the comeback.

unplayedCards.name: Incel
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: At round end, if you are the only friendly character here, gain +2 Hands, at most twice per match.

unplayedCards.name: Red Pill
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here. If already Weakened, Silence them and gain +2 Hands instead.

unplayedCards.name: Simmy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give the highest-Hands enemy here -3 Hands and your lowest-Hands other friendly character here +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Dragonfly Jones
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Target the enemy here with the most removable bonus Hands, otherwise the highest-cost enemy costing 4 or more, otherwise the strongest enemy. Hit it for 4 if it has bonus Hands or costs 4 or more; otherwise hit it for 2. Gain +1 Hand only if damage lands.

unplayedCards.name: Sho'Nuff
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 5 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus Hands and gain the amount actually taken. If no enemy has bonus Hands, hit the strongest enemy here for 3. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity apply.

unplayedCards.name: Mansa Musa
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other friendly character in each district +1 Hand, or +2 if that ally is Earth. Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

unplayedCards.name: TRON
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give up to three lowest-Hands other friendly characters here +1 Hands each. If all three gained Hands, restore 1 Motion.

unplayedCards.name: John Henry
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand for each other friendly Earth character across the board, up to +4. If at least two are here, give the strongest enemy here -2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Ashlee
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Drop Guyana the gorilla (+4, uncounterable) into your weakest friendly district. Give every other friendly character in Ashlee's district +1 Hand. Give the highest-Hands enemy on the board -1 Hand. If Plant allies occupy at least two districts, give your lowest-Hands Plant ally in each occupied district +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Homeless Guy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Choose 0–4 extra Motion; gain that many Hands, plus 1 if you invested any Motion. If the deployment cost alone spent your last Motion, instead steal up to 2 Hands from the strongest enemy here.

unplayedCards.name: Fangirl
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Your strongest other ally here becomes your idol. Ongoing: The first time your idol gains Hands each round, gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Grown-Man Fanboy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Your strongest other ally becomes your idol. Ongoing: Intercept the first hostile ability targeting your idol each round. If Fangirl is here when you take the hit, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Lawless YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move the weakest enemy here to their strongest other open district. If it moves, Lawless YN gains +1 Hand. Protection, immunity and movement locks can stop this.

unplayedCards.name: The Street Apostle
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first time another Plant ally gains Hands each round, repeat up to 2 of that gain onto your weakest Plant ally in each other district. Copied gains cannot trigger this again.

unplayedCards.name: The Asphalt Apostle
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest other Earth ally anywhere and give it +1 Hand. Ongoing: Once per round, block the first hostile forced move against an Earth ally; give that ally +2 Hands instead.

unplayedCards.name: Cologne Criminal
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Leave Lingering Scent here through the end of next round. The first enemy entering this district each round gets 2 Burn, even if moved here. Scent stays after you leave.

unplayedCards.name: Seafood Assassin
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply 2 Burn to every enemy here, then immediately detonate all their Burn as Hands damage and consume it. Protection blocks the whole hit.

unplayedCards.name: Homeless Legend
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Survive your first lethal Hands reduction at 1 Hand. At round end, recover up to 2 Hands lost to damage.

unplayedCards.name: God of Hookah
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply 1 Burn to the weakest unburned enemy character in another district. Ongoing: At round end, the first enemy damaged by Burn in each district passes 1 Burn to the weakest unburned enemy in the next district. New Burn waits until next round. If that district has enemies but all were already burning, gain +1 Hand, at most once per round.

unplayedCards.name: The Mailman
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Your second Electric character played each round sends a Package to your weakest other open district. The next Electric character played there costs 1 less Motion and gains +2 Hands. Only one Package can be pending.

unplayedCards.name: Lola
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Invite your weakest movable ally from each other district here. Cleanse each arrival and give it +1 Hand. At round end, send guests home with another +1 if they return. Needs space.

unplayedCards.name: Repo Man
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Tow the enemy with the most bonus Hands from another district here. If it arrives, give up to 3 of its bonus Hands to your weakest ally here. Protection, immunity and movement rules apply.

unplayedCards.name: Mad Hatter
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other ally here to hand with +1 Hand and −1 Motion on its next play (minimum 1). If there is room, pull your strongest movable ally from another district here. The cheaper guest also gains +3 Hands; the other gains Protection if still on the board. Equal costs: +1 Hand each. If alone here, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Track Suit Auntie
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district.

unplayedCards.name: Gym Bag YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Fitness ally to your weakest legal other district. One successful Bag Check per side per round.

unplayedCards.name: Stairwell Sprinter
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to an unvisited legal district. Gain +1 Hand after arrival once per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Last Set OG
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If a friendly Fitness character has visited all three districts, give your weakest Fitness ally in each occupied district +2 Hands. Otherwise Protect your weakest other local Fitness ally. One circuit finish per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: The Favorite Grandchild
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district.

unplayedCards.name: Cousin Back From College
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Fire or Family ally to your weakest legal other district. Only after arrival, give it +2 Hands once per side per round.

unplayedCards.name: Plate Auntie
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Recover up to 3 lost Hands and remove Burn from your weakest injured other local Fire or Family ally; Protect it if healing or Burn removal succeeds. If nobody is injured, remove one eligible ally’s Burn; if nobody needs either, give your weakest eligible ally +3 Hands instead. With no eligible ally, save +3 Hands for the next other Fire or Family ally arriving here through next round while Auntie is here and active; once, no echoes.

unplayedCards.name: Church Auntie’s Rival
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Fire or Family ally +1 Hand and Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Big Sister
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first different Fire or Family ally moving here each round gains +3 Hands. Three payouts per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: Second Plate Cousin
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: When another local Fire or Family ally genuinely gains Hands, gain +3 Hands. Once per round, two payouts per side per match. Copied gains cannot trigger sharing.

unplayedCards.name: Grill Uncle
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply 2 Burn to the strongest enemy here. Ongoing: Actual enemy Burn damage here grants +2 Hands once per round, twice per side per match. The first different Fire or Family ally successfully resolving an entrance here each round applies 1 Burn to the strongest enemy here, twice per side per match. Echoes do not count.

unplayedCards.name: Grandma Said Sit Down
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 2 Hands, or 4 if two distinct friendly characters moved this round. One successful entrance per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Gym Spotter YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Fitness ally +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move through next round grants +1 Hand once.

unplayedCards.name: Calisthenics YN
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Your first successful move each round gains +2 Hands. Two payouts per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: OG Calisthenics
unplayedCards.effect: In Hand: Your first successful Fitness move each round grants that athlete +1 Hand, twice per side per match. On Reveal: If Fitness allies occupy all three districts, give your weakest Fitness ally in each district +3 Hands. Otherwise give your weakest other local Fitness ally +3 Hands and Protection. Once per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: Night Bus Driver
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable ally from another district here if there is space. The first successful pickup by this driver gives the passenger +2 Hands per match; returns do not reset it.

unplayedCards.name: Community Cook
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Recover up to 4 lost Hands on your weakest injured other ally here; otherwise give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands. A Homeless recipient is also cleansed, gains +2 Hands and Protection. Cracked Head counts as Homeless. One meal per recipient per side per match; copies and returns cannot refeed the same recipient.

unplayedCards.name: Jump Rope Menace
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Your first distinct Fitness mover each round grants +2 Hands; the second grants +1 Hand. Each leg pays at most twice per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: Delivery App Cyclist
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district. Give your weakest other ally there +1 Hand after arrival, once per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Barbershop Heckler
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the strongest enemy with bonus Hands here. If any bonus was removed, your weakest other ally here gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Group Chat Instigator
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 1 Hand. If damage lands and two different friendly characters moved this round, hit the strongest enemy in another district for 1.

unplayedCards.name: Bluetooth Unc
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Remove Silence from your weakest silenced other ally here. If none is silenced, Protect your weakest other ally here instead.

unplayedCards.name: Booster
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 1 bonus Hand from the strongest enemy with bonus Hands here and gain that amount. One successful steal per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Indian Scammer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the strongest enemy with bonus Hands here. If bonus Hands were removed, give your weakest other local ally +1 Hand and Protection. Once per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Naija Scammer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Summon a 0-Motion / 1-Hand Fake Marriage token here if there is space, then Protect your weakest other character here. One summon per side per match. The token earns +1 Hand when a different ally moves here, once per round, twice per match.

unplayedCards.name: Black Air Fade 1’s
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other character here +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move this round grants +1 Hand once. One fitting per target per match.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Crafty
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly inmate or a friendly support card is here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Boyfriend
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands. Also give your weakest friendly Cellblock character in another district +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Informant
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy here -3 Hands. Protection and immunity can block this.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Contraband
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly character is here, restore 1 Motion, up to the Motion cap.

unplayedCards.name: Regular guy named LeBron James
unplayedCards.effect: A fictional regular guy. On Reveal: Cleanse and Protect your weakest other ally here. Once per match, when that Protection blocks an enemy ability, hit its source for 3.

unplayedCards.name: Alice
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: At round end, return to your hand once per match, except during the final round. Your next deployment gains +3 Hands and costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1.

unplayedCards.name: Queen of Hearts
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Execute the weakest enemy here if it has 6 or fewer Hands. A successful execution summons a 2-Hand Card Guard. Protection can block execution.

unplayedCards.name: Mr Rabbit
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, other friendly characters returned to hand cost 1 less Motion on their next deployment (minimum 1). While on the board, gain +1 Hand each time another friendly character returns to hand.

unplayedCards.name: Undercova Brotha
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy deployed here resolves its entrance, steal 2 Hands plus up to 2 removable bonus Hands, gaining only the actual amount taken, up to 4. Escape to your weakest other open district only if Hands were taken. At most two payouts per side per match; copies share the limit.

unplayedCards.name: The Feds
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 8 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus and Lock it. If no enemy has bonus Hands, Lock and Weaken the strongest enemy here instead. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity block the whole package.

unplayedCards.name: DMV Worker
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Post one queue ticket here through next round and gain +1 Hand. The next enemy character entrance here waits until round end, then resolves if that character is still active. One ticket per district per side; no repeat delay.

unplayedCards.name: Bonnet Girl
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first time an enemy damages another ally here, gain +2 Hands. Once per match.

unplayedCards.name: Corrupt Pastor
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Take 1 Hand from each other ally here, leaving each with at least 1. Gain 2 Hands per actual donation.

unplayedCards.name: Powerhouse
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, bank up to 3 Motion refunded by other cards. On Reveal: Deal that much damage to every enemy here.

unplayedCards.name: Revolutionary Ronald
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first time each round an enemy damages another ally here, Protect your weakest movable character in another district, then bring it here if there is room.

unplayedCards.name: Trap Vamp
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, when your ability damages an enemy here, gain that much Hands, up to 2.

unplayedCards.name: SquabbleHouse Cook
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, when an enemy ability damages another ally here, deal 2 damage back to its source.

unplayedCards.name: SquabbleHouse Server
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse Burn and Freeze from your weakest affected ally here.

unplayedCards.name: Sugarfoot
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. If it was already Weakened, gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: YN Gokarter
